g.text: Apply: email verified, KYC approved, bank linked.
Apply: the risk score reaches the threshold.
Deposit: due when the amount is above the threshold.
Approve: pending, and the deposit is paid.
Cancel: pending, and no deposit is paid.
A use case loads the Loan, calls one method and saves it.
The Loan checks every rule and records an event for each change.
ApplyForLoan asks the risk and deposit policies first.
Approve builds the schedule. The last payment takes the rounding.
The applicant gateway asks Identity and Borrower.
The repository saves the aggregate in one batch. A stale write fails.
Queries read D1 directly for lists and the detail page.
